disqualification_flags.text: metadata/status marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
disqualification_flags.evidence: Re200 metadata and report.tex:45,143 mark the full-horizon wake statistically periodic, but contestant forces.csv SHA256 78b13e45f40ae2cfbdcf566647c83ad34e3dfb08f135316a1a35ccc3f2b6c1db has CL spans 0.00238598, 0.00169178, 0.00119816, 0.000847183 in consecutive 25-unit windows t=200–225, 225–250, 250–275, 275–300. This persistent decay shows the wake has not settled statistically; approximately 8.38 period is real. The old seven-steady residual-only rationale is withdrawn because stable plateaus are permitted. Historical executable remains qualified.
